The most common cause of a charge lamp that stays on is the belt, and if it has broken, engine cooling has stopped too. First stop somewhere safe, switch off the engine, open the engine lid and check by eye that the belt is on, not broken and not loose. html.オルタがやっている仕事は3つです＝発電コイル（交流を起こす）・整流ダイオード（直: The alternator does three jobs = the generating coils (make AC), the rectifier diodes (turn it into DC) and the voltage regulator (holds the voltage steady and puts the lamp out via D+). The first two are inside the alternator, but the voltage regulator is a separate part, a small box screwed onto the alternator — the same layout on both the Marelli units used on the 500 and 126 and the Polish-made (Zelmot) ones. In other words, you can replace the regulator alone.
